label: TP
reason: User input flows through URL decoding and passes through doSomething() where escapeHtml() is applied, but escapeHtml() does NOT sanitize % characters needed for format string attacks. The tainted value reaches response.getWriter().format() sink where % sequences in user input will be interpreted as format specifiers (%n for newline, %% for literal %, etc.) causing XSS/format string vulnerability.

evidence.note: URL decode -> escapeHtml -> format sink; escapeHtml misses % chars enabling format string attack
